CAVEATS: QLoRA fine-tune released as the evaluated artifact of a training-corpus-overlap study. CC-BY-NC-4.0. MedXpertQA Text improves 17.5 -> 24.5 (full) and 15.6 -> 20.8 (exact-stem-unflagged), but the card itself reports MedQA REGRESSING 74.0 -> 67.6 and flags overlap contamination in the medical benchmarks. Confidence intervals printed (+/-1.6 and +1.9).
